details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)\leq2\,\mathrm{VC}_{\mathrm{extr}}(\mathcal H)-1$; equivalently $\mathrm{VC}_{\mathrm{extr}}(\mathcal H)\geq(\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+1)/2$.
proof: Theorem 9 of the cited paper proves $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal E)\leq2\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal E)-1$ for every finite extremal class $\mathcal E$. Apply it to a minimum-VC extremal extension of $\mathcal H$ and use spherical-dimension monotonicity under inclusion.
name: Extremal-Extension VC Dimension / Spherical Dimension (affine)
